app.setup.title_default.why: States the missing precondition plainly, matching the Apple term 延伸功能 rather than a synonym.

app.setup.title_failed.why: Hedges on the check itself, not the extension's state, so it reads distinct from the plain not-yet-on title.

app.setup.detail_default.s: 網站一旦受到防護，就無法再劫持你的點按。
app.setup.detail_default.back: site once receives guard, then cannot again hijack your press
app.setup.detail_default.why: One plain sentence with the app's whole payoff; 點按 covers tap and click on both platforms.

app.setup.detail_failed.s: 這次暫時問不到 Safari 的狀態，只要延伸功能開啟，這裡就會自動更新。
app.setup.detail_failed.back: this-time temporarily can't-ask Safari's status, as-long-as extension opens, here then will automatically update
app.setup.detail_failed.why: No error code, and reassures the person nothing further needs doing.

app.setup.open_button.why: Names the single action only, so it works unchanged on both the setup screen and the welcome sheet.

app.welcome.heading.why: The one warm line in the product; keeps the brand name untranslated.

app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.tit.why: Concrete noun for the trick, no marketing language.

app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.s: 看不見的覆蓋層可能蓋住頁面，讓點按落在別的東西上。
app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.back: invisible overlay might cover page, let press land on other thing
app.welcome.feature.invisible_layers.det.why: Describes what the person would experience, not the DOM mechanism.

app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.title.why: Short noun phrase naming the specific trick.

app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.s: 有些網站會在按下與放開之間，偷偷換掉連結的目的地。
app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.back: some sites will between press and release, secretly swap link's destination
app.welcome.feature.swapped_links.detail.why: States the press/release timing plainly, matching the vocabulary term 目的地.

app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.ti.why: Names a pop-up or tab opening somewhere the person did not press toward.

app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.s: 防護開啟後，新分頁只會開向你點按的目的地，不會多開別的。
app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.back: guard on after, new tab only will open-toward your pressed destination, won't extra-open other
app.welcome.feature.uninvited_windows.de.why: Written as the promise the brief asks for, not a description of the trick.

app.welcome.feature.every_destination.ti.why: Names the rule-list feature, tracking every destination not just the caught ones.

app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.s: 每個目的地都會列出來，你可以選擇在這個網站或所有網站允許或封鎖。
app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.back: every destination all will be-listed, you can choose at this site or all sites allow or block
app.welcome.feature.every_destination.de.why: Uses 這個網站/所有網站 as the fixed scope pair kept consistent across the whole app.

app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.t.why: Names the per-site opt-in mechanism, not an always-on default.

app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.s: 在 Safari 工具列按下 Undirect 按鈕，就能為這個網站開啟防護。
app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.back: at Safari toolbar press Undirect button, then can for this site open guard
app.welcome.feature.one_site_at_a_time.d.why: Names the exact mechanism: the toolbar button, plain and concrete.

app.nav.guarded_sites.why: Short enough for a narrow sidebar column and doubles as the screen's own title.

app.nav.settings.why: Apple's own term for this screen on both iOS and macOS; no synonym invented.

app.nav.app_title.why: Proper noun, left untranslated like any other app's own name.

app.rules.grouping.everywhere.why: Fixed scope term, paired against 個別網站 below.

app.rules.grouping.by_site.why: Reads as the clear opposite of 所有網站 sitting beside it in the sidebar.

app.rules.empty_no_app.title.why: A wiring state, distinct in wording from the content-empty title below it.

app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.s: 在 Safari 開啟任一網站，這裡就會顯示資料。
app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.back: at Safari open any-one site, here then will show data
app.rules.empty_no_app.detail.why: One plain fix, no setting to change; shared verbatim with the Guarded Sites screen.

app.rules.empty_no_rules.title.why: States the content-empty case, contrasting with the wiring-empty title above.

app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.s: 允許或封鎖過目的地後，才會出現在這裡。
app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.back: allowed or blocked destination after, only-then will appear here
app.rules.empty_no_rules.detail.why: Explains a row is created by a decision, not merely by the guard noticing something.

app.rules.footer.lifetime_count.why: %lld kept exactly as the brief's placeholder; Chinese has no plural form, so one string serves every count.

app.rules.row.state_blocked.why: Pairs cleanly as the opposite of 已允許 in the same row list.

app.rules.row.action_allow.why: Bare imperative verb, distinct from the state label 已允許 shown elsewhere.

app.rules.row.action_block.why: Bare imperative verb, only shown on a row currently Allowed.

app.rules.row.help_tooltip.s: 選擇要允許還是封鎖這個目的地
app.rules.row.help_tooltip.back: choose want allow or-else block this destination
app.rules.row.help_tooltip.why: Describes what the hovered control does, in one short phrase.

app.rules.row.use_default.why: Names clearing the rule, not setting a new verdict; kept identical to the extension's ext.action.clear in meaning.

app.watched.empty.title.why: States plainly that no site has been switched on.

app.watched.empty.detail.s: 在 Safari 工具列按下 Undirect 按鈕，就能防護目前的網站。
app.watched.empty.detail.back: at Safari toolbar press Undirect button, then can guard current site
app.watched.empty.detail.why: Gives the exact first action, matching the toolbar-button vocabulary term.

app.watched.footer.s: 只能透過 Safari 工具列的按鈕新增網站。
app.watched.footer.back: only can through Safari toolbar's button add site
app.watched.footer.why: Reminds the person this screen has no add control of its own.

app.watched.row.guarded_badge.why: Read-only status word, not a button, for the iOS row.

app.watched.row.stop_button.why: Short imperative verb sized for a trailing row button.

app.watched.row.stop_tooltip.why: Describes what the Stop button under the pointer does.

app.settings.guard_toggle.why: One word, the same root term used for the guard concept throughout the app and extension.

app.settings.state_on.why: Generic on/off word, reused for more than one setting on this screen.

app.settings.mode_heading.why: Introduces the choice of which sites the guard runs on.

app.settings.mode_watched.why: Described from the person's own point of view, as the brief asks, not as a technical mode name.

app.settings.mode_everywhere.why: Names the automatic always-on mode plainly.

app.settings.banner_toggle.why: Matches the vocabulary concept 'note in the page', kept identical to the extension's own toggle.

app.settings.policy_heading.s: 沒有規則時的預設動作
app.settings.policy_heading.why: Introduces the choice for a destination with no rule set at all.

app.settings.policy_block.why: Short picker option, using the fixed 封鎖 term.

app.settings.policy_allow.why: Clear opposite of 預設封鎖.

ext.meta.name.why: Proper noun, left untranslated in the Extensions list and the App Store.

ext.meta.description.s: 防止網站劫持你的點按，把你偷偷開啟新視窗或跳轉到別的網址。
ext.meta.description.back: prevent site hijack your press, put you secretly open new window or redirect to other address
ext.meta.description.why: Written for someone who has never used it, spelling out the click-hijack and redirect cases plainly.

ext.meta.app_title.why: Fallback display name, used only when no actual site name is available.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_on.why: States that guarding is currently on for the active tab's site.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_off.why: Doubles as state and call to action, since a press here is the one-tap way to start guarding.

ext.toolbar.tooltip_no_site.why: Explains briefly there is nothing to guard on a tab with no website loaded.

ext.popup.no_site_title.why: Headline for the empty-state layout when the tab has no website.

ext.popup.no_site_body.s: 開啟網站後，點這裡即可防護。
ext.popup.no_site_body.back: open site after, press here then-can guard
ext.popup.no_site_body.why: '這裡' keeps the brief's self-reference to the toolbar button the popup hangs off.

ext.popup.watch_switch_label.s: 開啟或關閉這個網站的防護
ext.popup.watch_switch_label.back: open or close this site's guard
ext.popup.watch_switch_label.why: Screen-reader-only label naming what the switch controls, since the visible row already shows the site name.

ext.popup.watch_unknown.why: Explains briefly why the switch is disabled: there is no page here.

ext.popup.watch_everywhere_mode.s: 所有網站的防護已在設定中開啟
ext.popup.watch_everywhere_mode.back: all sites' guard already at Settings opened
ext.popup.watch_everywhere_mode.why: Points to Settings as the reason this one switch is now redundant.

ext.popup.watch_master_off.why: Points to the master switch, not to anything about this particular site.

ext.popup.watch_on.s: 此網站防護已開啟，關閉後頁面會重新載入。
ext.popup.watch_on.back: this site guard already opened, close after page will reload
ext.popup.watch_on.why: Confirms the state and warns of the reload, sharing one sentence shape with watch_off.

ext.popup.watch_off.s: 此網站防護已關閉，開啟後頁面會重新載入。
ext.popup.watch_off.back: this site guard already closed, open after page will reload
ext.popup.watch_off.why: Direct before/after counterpart to watch_on, same sentence shape.

ext.popup.page_heading.why: Heads the tab-specific list, distinct from the site-wide Rules list.

ext.popup.page_off.s: 防護關閉中，本頁面沒有記錄
ext.popup.page_off.back: guard closing-in-progress, this page has-no record
ext.popup.page_off.why: Dead key as of 2026-09-22 per the brief; written speculatively to match the sibling page-section states, not verified against any live screen.

ext.popup.page_quiet.s: 本頁面目前沒有偵測到任何嘗試
ext.popup.page_quiet.back: this page currently has-no detected any attempt
ext.popup.page_quiet.why: States plainly that nothing has tried to reach outside so far.

ext.popup.page_empty.why: Dead key per the brief, treated as a near-synonym of page_quiet rather than a distinct phrasing, as instructed.

ext.popup.stopped_one.why: Chinese carries no singular/plural split, so this and stopped_other share one string; $COUNT$ kept as named.

ext.popup.stopped_other.why: Same string as stopped_one; the language has one plural pair, not two, per the brief's own note to use the target language's own rule.

ext.popup.seen_one.why: Broader than 封鎖: counts every recorded attempt, blocked and allowed together.

ext.popup.seen_other.why: Same string as seen_one; no plural split in Chinese.

ext.popup.tries_one.why: Terse fragment sized to sit among other comma-joined details in one row.

ext.popup.tries_other.why: Same string as tries_one; no plural split in Chinese.

ext.popup.recipe_heading.why: Two-word lead-in fragment meant to prefix the fix's own name after a colon.

ext.state.blocked.why: Most-reused status word; short enough to combine with a following scope fragment.

ext.state.allowed.why: Clear opposite of 已封鎖, same combination requirement.

ext.state.removed.why: Distinct word for a trap taken off the page itself, since there is no destination here to allow or block.

ext.scope.here.why: Written as a parenthetical so it reads naturally when the code appends it after a verdict word, e.g. 已封鎖（僅此網站）.

ext.scope.everywhere.why: Same parenthetical composition as scope.here, e.g. 已允許（所有網站）.

ext.scope.default.why: Same parenthetical composition, e.g. 已封鎖（依預設）ships without an explicit rule.

ext.action.allow_here.why: Complete standalone menu option, distinct from the everywhere variant.

ext.action.block_here.why: Complete standalone option scoped to the current site.

ext.popup.policy_heading.s: 沒有規則時的預設動作
ext.popup.policy_heading.why: Same concept and wording as the app's settings screen equivalent, kept consistent across surfaces.

ext.policy.block.why: Short radio option label, same wording as the app-side equivalent.

ext.policy.allow.why: Clear opposite of 預設封鎖.

ext.popup.bridge_warning.s: 這個網站的安全性設定擋下部分防護程式，此頁面的保護並不完整。
ext.popup.bridge_warning.back: this site's security settings blocked part-of guard script, this page's protection is not complete
ext.popup.bridge_warning.why: Frames it as a limitation of this one page, not a bug to fix.

ext.kind.click_catcher.why: Short tag for an invisible clickable link or form placed over the page.

ext.kind.overlay.why: Broader than click_catcher: any see-through element, not specifically a clickable one.

ext.kind.synthetic_click.why: Names a click the page's own script dispatched, not a real press.

ext.kind.window_open.why: Taiwan's standard term for a pop-up window.

ext.kind.form_submit.why: Names a hidden form submitted to open a new tab, distinct from window_open.

ext.kind.href_swap.why: Same tag as the welcome sheet's swapped_links title, kept consistent.

ext.kind.back_hijack.why: Names a navigation fired right after the person's own back gesture.

ext.kind.redirect.why: Names the core same-tab redirect trick, distinct from a genuine new-tab or window case.

ext.kind.pop_tab.why: Names a tab opened behind the press, distinct from window_open's explicit window.open call.

ext.kind.network_rule.why: Names the strongest, earliest kind of block, before the request ever reached the page.

ext.reason.way_back.why: Explains the redirect's own destination carried a path back to the original site.

ext.reason.sized.why: Explains the window asked for a deliberate size rather than opening as a bare tab.

ext.reason.took_press.why: Very short footnote naming the core hijack pattern: riding another press rather than being pressed toward directly.

ext.reason.default_allow.why: Explains it went through only because nothing said to stop it.

ext.reason.own_code.why: Explains the window was vouched for because the opening code belonged to the site itself.

ext.popup.rules_link.why: Reused unchanged as the nav row, the screen's own heading, and the back button's accessible label.

ext.popup.back_link.why: Names the destination a chevron-only back button returns to, so it reads sensibly heard aloud with no visual context.

ext.rules.everywhere_heading.why: Same fixed scope term as app.rules.grouping.everywhere, kept consistent across surfaces.

ext.rules.by_site_heading.why: Same fixed scope term as app.rules.grouping.by_site.

ext.rules.empty.why: Terse single-row placeholder for either section.

ext.action.allow.why: Simpler context than allow_here/allow_everywhere since scope is already fixed by the section the row sits in.

ext.action.clear.why: Same action and wording as app.rules.row.use_default, phrased for the popup's tighter menu.

ext.popup.settings_heading.why: Matches Apple's own term, reused as the popup's nav row and that screen's own header.

ext.settings.guard_label.why: Same one-word root term as app.settings.guard_toggle, used for both the visible row and its sr-only switch label.

ext.settings.guard_on.why: Short state word sized to sit as a switch's own state name.

ext.settings.mode_heading.why: Same wording as app.settings.mode_heading for the same underlying setting.

ext.settings.mode_watched.why: Same wording as app.settings.mode_watched, kept consistent across the popup and the app.

ext.settings.banner_toggle.why: Same term as app.settings.banner_toggle for the same underlying feature.

ext.action.report.why: Names opening a pre-filled issue report; nothing is sent until the person submits it themselves.
